question_text:
Drag and drop the correct tokens to complete the following if-statement that checks if 'num' is between 10 and 20 inclusive and even:
[BLANK1] num [BLANK2] 10 [BLANK3] num [BLANK4] 20 [BLANK5] num % 2 [BLANK6] 0:
    print('Valid')

(The completed statement should read: if num >= 10 and num <= 20 and num % 2 == 0:)

Operator to check if num is less than or equal to 20
Logical operator to combine the next condition
Operator to test equality for even check
